operations.contract: Enumerate the exact place, transition and weighted-arc vocabulary.
operations.limitation: Unknown fields or duplicate names must be refused.

operations.contract: Compute post minus pre with declared row and column order.
operations.limitation: A zero incidence entry does not remove a self-loop enabling requirement.

operations.contract: Check every input-arc demand against the supplied marking.
operations.limitation: Individual enabledness is not simultaneous fireability.

operations.contract: Consume the input arcs and then produce the output arcs for one enabled transition.
operations.limitation: A non-enabled transition has no successful successor marking.

operations.contract: Check each step and retain every intermediate marking.
operations.limitation: A transition multiset alone does not certify a feasible order.

operations.contract: Check a supplied nonzero nonnegative place-weight vector against every transition column.
operations.limitation: This verifies the supplied certificate; it does not compute a complete invariant basis.

operations.contract: Check a supplied nonzero nonnegative transition-count vector against every place row.
operations.limitation: Zero aggregate change does not establish feasibility from the initial marking.

operations.contract: Compare weighted values of two declared markings.
operations.limitation: Equal weighted values do not prove reachability between the markings.

operations.contract: List pairs whose full pre/post supports are disjoint.
operations.limitation: This sufficient structural condition is not a complete characterization of independence.

operations.contract: Compare both two-step orders at a particular marking.
operations.limitation: Coenabled transitions can conflict; a missing second step is not a commutation witness.

operations.contract: Explore the complete finite state graph only within declared resource limits.
operations.limitation: Any token, state or edge limit breach must refuse a completeness claim.

operations.contract: List reachable markings with no enabled transition.
operations.limitation: A deadlock-free finite model is not proof of live production software.

operations.contract: Return a shortest action sequence to the exact requested marking.
operations.limitation: Breadth-first minimum length does not minimize time, cost or harm.

operations.contract: Compare observed finite maxima with a positive place-invariant upper bound.
operations.limitation: The invariant upper bound can be conservative and is not a measured capacity.

operations.contract: For every reachable marking, ask whether each transition can eventually be enabled.
operations.limitation: This explicit L4 definition concerns possibility, not scheduler fairness.

operations.contract: Find strongly connected reachable components with no outgoing edges.
operations.limitation: Terminal components can contain deadlocks or continuing cycles; neither establishes benefit.

operations.contract: Represent the mapping from synthetic tokens to possible process concepts.
operations.limitation: No energy, consciousness, physical substance or actual person is inferred from a token.

operations.contract: Represent missing measurement units and a future uncertainty model.
operations.limitation: Exact integer arithmetic has no sampling error here, but model inadequacy remains unknown.

operations.contract: Expose missing governed observations, baselines, preregistration and independent evaluation.
operations.limitation: Producing the gap record leaves the empirical claim open.

operations.contract: Expose missing target scope, affected-party authority and independent safety review.
operations.limitation: Producing the gate record does not authorize deployment or resolve professional duties.

scope: Finite synthetic same-owner software and documentation evidence only. No empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, independent reproduction, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, Theory-of-Everything proof or Stage 20 readiness. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
